reviews.text:
The best place for our purring friends! Plenty of hiding places, toys, and lots of attention from Alice, who often gave us updates.
Despite his temperamental nature, our cat Cookie loved his stay, and we were reassured throughout by little messages and photos :)

My 5-year-old cat had his first experience at a cattery this year: a 15-day stay at the end of August/beginning of September. I was a little apprehensive about being separated from him for so long, and I can say I'm delighted to have found Moustache Cattery. The email communication beforehand was very clear, from the initial information gathering to the quote confirmation. Alice reassured me and took excellent care of my cat; I received updates and photos very regularly.
The Moustache team was incredibly attentive and adapted to my pet's pace of acclimatization to group living. The place is clean, bright, well laid out, and you can see that the guests are pampered, happy, and relaxed. He'll be back, that's for sure!

A 5-star boarding facility! I was worried about leaving Choupette for three weeks this summer. She's a Sacred Birman, very attached to her parents, four years old, and had never seen another cat before. The result is fantastic!! When we picked her up, she was calm and very sociable. Thank you to the team; it's a pleasure to find such passionate people.

Fantastic experience with our one-year-old cat, who was on his first long stay this summer after shorter ones last year! Alice managed to tame our little wild one, who gradually relaxed and discovered lots of games and friends... We found him in great shape! And Alice sent us updates throughout the holiday, which was wonderful!

So, yes, boarding your cat does come at a cost, and you need to factor it into your vacation budget, but Le Moustache takes excellent care of our pet while we're away, and we can leave with complete peace of mind. I've boarded my cat there twice this year, and I highly recommend the service. Their boarding requirements are strict but necessary and very reassuring, the facility is pleasant, well-suited, and well-maintained, and the people who run it are absolutely lovely! A huge thank you to them!

This is the second time we've entrusted our cat to this cattery, and we're very happy with it. 🐱❤️

The first time, we only left her for four days to try it out before a longer stay. Everything went very well, so we decided to trust them again for our three-week vacation.

Three weeks was a long time for us 😅, but our cat also thoroughly enjoyed her vacation! She made friends, seemed very comfortable, and was well settled in.

We could regularly see her in the stories they posted. And when I asked for updates, they always replied the same day.

We will definitely use this cattery again for our future trips. Thank you for taking such good care of her!

Perfect boarding for our Théa, who just spent three weeks there. Alice and Amélie take excellent care of all their guests, who thrive in a fantastic play area with plenty of hiding places. It's a real summer camp! 😻 They post daily updates via Instagram.
I highly recommend it!!

I entrusted Saraby to Moustache for 10 days and she was welcomed and treated like a queen! I couldn't have dreamed of anything better for my kitty, and I wouldn't hesitate to entrust her to them again!

It's such a joy to be able to leave our cat at Moustache boarding kennel.

We have complete confidence in them, and it allows our cat to have a wonderful holiday surrounded by love. We highly recommend them!

Aldo had a fantastic experience at Moustache Pension! 🐱❤️ The team is lovely, professional, and truly attentive to the animals. I really appreciated their care and kindness, and especially knowing that Aldo was in good hands while I was away. He seemed very happy and relaxed when he returned 😊

I highly recommend Moustache Pension to all owners looking for a trustworthy place to board their cat!
